export.hint.en: Export one resource as YAML, or multiple YAML files in a ZIP.
export.hint.zh-CN: 单个资源导出为 YAML，多个资源分别生成 YAML 后打包为 ZIP。

export.secret_hint.en: Export full Secret YAML, including Secret values. Multiple resources are saved as a ZIP.
export.secret_hint.zh-CN: 导出完整 Secret YAML，包含 Secret 实际值；多个资源打包为 ZIP。

export.dialog_failed.en: Could not open the resource export save dialog.
export.dialog_failed.zh-CN: 无法打开资源导出的保存对话框。

export.empty.en: Select at least one resource to export.
export.empty.zh-CN: 请至少选择一个要导出的资源。

export.replaced.en: This resource was replaced. Refresh the list and select it again.
export.replaced.zh-CN: 此资源已被重建，请刷新列表并重新选择。

export.failed.en: Resource export failed; the destination was not replaced. %{error}
export.failed.zh-CN: 资源导出失败，目标文件未被替换。%{error}

export.resource_failed.en: Could not export %{target}; the destination was not replaced. %{error}
export.resource_failed.zh-CN: 无法导出 %{target}，目标文件未被替换。%{error}
